measurement.note: Budgets are regression ceilings, not marketing benchmarks. Run npm run perf:f0 on an otherwise idle host.

httpSteadyState._note: p97_5Milliseconds, not p95: autocannon 8 exposes p90 and p97_5 and has no latency.p95, so the harness never measured a p95 despite the field being called one. The number is unchanged (750) — it was always being compared against p97.5, which is stricter than the label claimed. Renamed so the ceiling means what it says.
